newsitem.title: USA: SpeedFam files to offer 3 mln common shrs.
newsitem.headline: SpeedFam files to offer 3 mln common shrs.

text.p: SpeedFam International Inc said Thursday it filed with the Securities and Exchange Commission to sell up to three million common shares.

Of the total, 2.05 million common will be sold by the company and 950,000 common will be offered for sale by selling shareholdings. After the offering, outstanding shares will total 12,662,485 common.

The company granted the underwriters a 30-day over-allotment option to buy up to 450,000 additional common shares. The offering will be made through Lehman Bros, Alex. Browns & Sons Inc and Needham & Co Inc, the filing said.

Proceeds will be used to pay costs for constructing and equipping a new manufacturing and office facility; to fund additional capital expenditures; to repay certain debt; for working capital and general corporate purposes.
The Chandler, Ariz., based company designs, develops, manufactures, markets and services chemical mechanical polishing systems for semiconductor and disk storage markets.
